import tilelang as tl
import tilelang.tir as T  # TileLang's TIR namespace

# TileLang kernel: fp16 tanh activation (GPU)

@tl.prim_func
def tanh_kernel(
    A: T.handle,               # input buffer (fp16)
    B: T.handle,               # output buffer (fp16)
    N: T.int64,                # first dimension size
    M: T.int64                 # second dimension size
) -> None:

    A_buf = T.match_buffer(A, (N, M), dtype="float16")
    B_buf = T.match_buffer(B, (N, M), dtype="float16")

    total = N * M
    block_dim = 256

                j = linear_idx % M
                x_fp16 = A_buf[i, j]
                # Compute tanh in fp32 for better numerical stability

                y_fp32 = T.tanh(x_fp32)
                y_fp16 = T.Cast("float16", y_fp32)
                B_buf[i, j] = y_fp16
